The RouterOS REST API is a JSON wrapper over the RouterOS console API, available from RouterOS v7.1beta4+. It provides CRUD operations on all RouterOS configuration menus via standard HTTP methods. Authentication uses HTTP Basic Auth with console credentials. All values in responses are encoded as strings.
